newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was slow in the panhandle area late Tuesday. Slaughter steers and heifers closed steady.

Feedlots reported light to moderate inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 3,200 slaughter steers and 2,500 heifers; 18,400 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 12,100 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Steers - select and choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 72.00. Pen select, few choice 2-3 1200 lbs 71.00.
Heifers - select and choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 72.00. Pen select, few choice 2-3 1100 lbs 71.00.
Wk to Date: 18,400 Week Ago: 115,900 Year Ago: 32,200
